title: Three Saturdays and One Short Strap
subtitle: 服饰配件 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服饰配件（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）
meta: 主题语境：服饰配件（人与自我·生活与学习·个人仪表与穿着）　|　核心词汇：handbag　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 handbag 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the maker ① repaired a handbag that no customer in the shop would have described, and he said the repairing was the whole of the Saturday. The ② handbag, meaning the bag itself and not the strap, ran three Saturdays and stayed undescribed in the book; a handbag, he said, is the only thing in a shop that is judged by how long it is left undescribed.

Every ③ handbag in that shop had the same short strap beside it, and the ④ handbag at the far shelf, meaning the one they kept for the children and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A handbag, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to describe; the maker said the describing is the part that fills three Saturdays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the handbag was the whole of the matter, meaning the purse and not the bag. The ⑥ handbag, meaning the purse and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody describes; handbag, he said, is either something you repair or the only word that means both a bag and a purse. He said the purse is the part they remember.

By 1981 the ⑦ handbag had become a line in a list, and the list had become an argument about the short strap. The ⑧ handbag of the whole thing, the maker wrote in November, was one shop and three Saturdays of describing; handbag, he said, is either the one at the far shelf or the reason you learned to describe. He said the describing was never mentioned.

The ⑨ handbag I remember is the one described in the list, which closed in 1983 and is still described as the quietest in the shop. A ⑩ handbag, my mother said in 1985, is the only one that improves by being described; every handbag, she said, is a purse that has agreed to look like a bag. She said the purse was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 手提包（指店里每一只旁边的那一只）
B. n. 手提包（指那只袋子本身，与背带相对）
C. 固定搭配：repair a handbag 修补一只手提包
D. n. 手提包（指留给孩子们学着用的那一只）
E. n. 手袋（抽象总称，指一家铺子的手袋之事）
F. n. 手提包（指清单里写到、被登记过的那一只）
G. n. 钱包；随身小包（指一件事里人人都带却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 细软（抽象总称，指人人都带却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: repaired a handbag that no customer in the shop would have described
The handbag, meaning the bag itself and not the strap
the handbag at the far shelf
the handbag was the whole of the matter
the handbag had become a line in a list
The handbag of the whole thing
A handbag, my mother said in 1985

answers.why: repair a handbag 意为“修补一只手提包”，1976 年那位匠人修补了店里没有一位顾客肯描述的一只手提包。
handbag 意为“手提包”，指那只袋子本身而不是背带，它经过了三个星期六而在簿子上没有被描述。
handbag 意为“手提包”，指店里每一只旁边的那一只，每一只旁边都有同一条矮矮的带子。
handbag 意为“手提包”，指最远那层架上留给孩子们学着用的那一只，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
handbag 意为“钱包、随身小包”，指一件事里人人都带却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这只小包就是那件事的全部。
handbag 意为“细软”，指人人都带却无人提起的那样东西而不是那只手提包，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
handbag 意为“手提包”，指清单里写到、被登记过的那一只，到 1984 年这一只成了清单里的一行。
handbag 意为“手袋”，匠人十一月写道，整件事的手袋之事是一家铺子和三个星期六的描述。
handbag 意为“手提包”，我记得的是清单里描述过的那一只，1983 年补好了，至今仍被说成店里最安静的一只。
handbag 为抽象总称，母亲 1985 年说，手提包是唯一会因为被好好描述而变得更好的包。
